name: Survival / Crafting
description: Survive, gather, craft and build in a hostile world, on top of a simulated world with weather and a day/night cycle.

pillars.name: Survival Needs
pillars.description: Health, hunger, thirst, temperature and how they pressure the player.

pillars.name: Hunger and Thirst
pillars.description: Food and water as a constant pressure.

pillars.name: Temperature
pillars.description: Exposure to cold and heat, and how shelter and clothing help.

pillars.name: Gathering
pillars.description: Collecting resources from the world: tools, nodes and yields.

pillars.name: Crafting
pillars.description: Turning resources into tools, gear and supplies.

pillars.name: Recipes
pillars.description: Recipe unlocks: what can be made and how the player discovers it.

pillars.name: Stations
pillars.description: Workbenches and other stations that gate recipes.

pillars.name: Building
pillars.description: Placing structures and bases: snapping, stability and upgrades.

pillars.name: World
pillars.description: The environment the player survives in.

pillars.name: World Generation
pillars.description: Procedural or authored terrain, biomes and resource placement.

pillars.name: Day and Night
pillars.description: The day/night cycle and how danger changes with it.

pillars.name: Weather
pillars.description: Weather systems and how they affect survival.

pillars.name: Threats
pillars.description: Creatures and other dangers, and the AI that drives them.

pillars.name: Persistence
pillars.description: Saving the world, bases and inventory, and keeping saves compatible.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.description: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
